PHYS 101
Physics for
Engineers I
This course introduces fundamental
principles of mechanics, energy
conservation, and wave phenomena
with hands-on laboratory sessions.
Coursework includes
problem-solving workshops, lab
reports, and midterm and final
assessments.
Meets Tuesdays and Thursdays
9:00 A.M.–10:15 A.M.
Prerequisite:
Calculus I.
Open to engineering
majors.
